background.prompt: 生成一张全新的图片：16:9 横幅，不要任何文字、水印、logo。黑白低饱和的电影画面，冷峻安静。浓雾笼罩着一片辽阔平坦的高原，远处隐约是更高的山峰。前景右侧一个失焦模糊的人物侧身剪影，低着头，雾气流动，有胶片颗粒。

lines.zh: 为什么很多人付出了努力，却迟迟等不来改变呢？
lines.en: Why do so many people put in the effort, yet change never seems to come?

lines.zh: 因为很多成长不是一点一点发生的，而是在某一天突然发生的。
lines.en: Because much of growth doesn't happen bit by bit; it happens suddenly, one day.

lines.zh: 只是在那之前，你要先熬过一段毫无变化的日子。
lines.en: But before that, you have to endure a stretch where nothing seems to change.

lines.zh: 而人最难承受的，往往不是辛苦，
lines.en: And what's hardest to bear is often not the hard work,

lines.zh: 而是付出之后，看不到任何回应。
lines.en: but giving everything and seeing no response at all.

lines.zh: 心理学中有一个概念，叫做高原现象。
lines.en: Psychology has a concept called the learning plateau.

lines.zh: 它指的是练习到某个阶段，进步会突然停滞，
lines.en: It means that at some stage of practice, progress suddenly stalls,

lines.zh: 像走上了一片平坦的高原。
lines.en: as if you've walked onto a flat plateau.

lines.zh: 1897年，布赖恩和哈特研究电报员学发电码，
lines.en: In 1897, Bryan and Harter studied telegraph operators learning Morse code,

lines.zh: 发现他们的速度会长时间停滞不前，
lines.en: and found their speed stalled for a long time,

lines.zh: 然后在某一天，突然跃升到一个新的水平。
lines.en: then one day suddenly jumped to a new level.

lines.zh: 原来高原期并不是没有进步，
lines.en: It turned out the plateau was not a lack of progress,

lines.zh: 而是大脑正在悄悄重组：
lines.en: but the brain quietly reorganizing:

lines.zh: 从一个字母一个字母地听，变成整个单词地听。
lines.en: from hearing letter by letter to hearing whole words.

lines.zh: 也就是说，你看不到变化，不是因为什么都没发生，
lines.en: In other words, you see no change not because nothing is happening,

lines.zh: 而是变化正发生在你看不见的地方。
lines.en: but because change is happening where you can't see it.

lines.zh: 可我们太习惯用结果来确认努力，
lines.en: But we are too used to judging effort by results;

lines.zh: 看不到回报，就开始怀疑方向，怀疑自己，
lines.en: when no reward shows, we start doubting the direction, and ourselves,

lines.zh: 于是很多人，恰恰停在了快要越过高原的时候。
lines.en: so many people stop just as they are about to cross the plateau.

lines.zh: 我一直觉得，高原期最难熬的地方不是累，
lines.en: I've always felt the hardest part of a plateau isn't the fatigue,

lines.zh: 而是安静，安静到让你以为，自己被世界忘记了。
lines.en: but the silence, so quiet you think the world has forgotten you.

lines.zh: 当然，不是所有停滞都意味着突破，
lines.en: Of course, not every stall means a breakthrough is coming;

lines.zh: 有时方向真的错了，需要的是调整，而不是硬撑。
lines.en: sometimes the direction is wrong, and you need to adjust, not grit your teeth.

lines.zh: 真正重要的，是分清自己在原地打转，还是在积蓄力量。
lines.en: What matters is telling whether you're going in circles or building strength.

lines.zh: 如果是后者，就不必急着向这段日子要答案。
lines.en: If it's the latter, don't rush these days for an answer.

lines.zh: 它也许不会立刻奖励你，
lines.en: They may not reward you right away,

lines.zh: 但总有一天，会把你送到一个新的地方。
lines.en: but one day, they will carry you somewhere new.
